remediation_steps.step:
Back up the current Terraform file so the change is reversible.

Command:
    cp /opt/vuln-labs/cspm-lab/main.tf /opt/vuln-labs/cspm-lab/main.tf.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

Why: Backing up the Terraform file ensures that any changes made can be easily reverted if necessary, maintaining the integrity of the infrastructure as code.

Enable key rotation for the KMS key by updating the Terraform configuration.

Command:
    sed -i 's/enable_key_rotation     = false/enable_key_rotation     = true/' /opt/vuln-labs/cspm-lab/main.tf

Why: Enabling key rotation helps mitigate the risk of key compromise by ensuring that the encryption key is periodically changed, as recommended by AWS security best practices.

Plan the Terraform changes to ensure the configuration is correct before applying.

Command:
    cd /opt/vuln-labs/cspm-lab && terraform plan -detailed-exitcode

Why: Running a Terraform plan allows you to preview the changes that will be made to the infrastructure, ensuring that the configuration is correct and will not cause unintended disruptions.

Apply the Terraform changes to enable key rotation on the KMS key.

Command:
    terraform apply -auto-approve

Why: Applying the Terraform changes updates the infrastructure to enable key rotation on the KMS key, aligning with security best practices.

Verify that key rotation is enabled for the KMS key using the AWS CLI.

Command:
    KEY_ID=$(terraform state show aws_kms_key.vulnerable_key | awk -F'"' '/^[[:space:]]+id[[:space:]]+/{print $2; exit}') && aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id "$KEY_ID"

Why: Verifying the key rotation status ensures that the configuration change has been successfully applied and that the key is now set to rotate automatically.

Re-scan the configuration with Checkov to confirm that the CKV_AWS_7 check passes.

Command:
    checkov -d /opt/vuln-labs/cspm-lab/ --check CKV_AWS_7 --output json --quiet --compact

Why: Re-scanning with Checkov ensures that the remediation has been successful and that the configuration now complies with the security policy.
